hero_subtitle: Explore how North Northamptonshire Council manages public money. Budget analysis powered by GOV.UK MHCLG data.
publisher_bio: This website was created by Tom Pickup, Reform UK county councillor for Padiham and Burnley West and Cabinet Member for Adult Social Care at Lancashire County Council. He is also parish councillor for Clowbridge with Dunnockshaw. Tom builds transparency tools that make public spending data easier to check.
publisher_titles: County Councillor for Padiham and Burnley West
Cabinet Member for Adult Social Care, Lancashire County Council
Parish Councillor for Clowbridge with Dunnockshaw
publisher_quote: It's your money. The more people understand where it goes, the better.

spend_triangulation.note: Transparency gross = £1.84B across every class in the published corpus. Procurement-paid (discretionary third-party payments) = £1.79B. Non-procurement rows: Care-Act redacted direct payments to individuals (£47.5M) — all excluded from third-party-supplier forensic analyses. Net revenue budget figures (where published) are smaller again because they net capital, grants received, and reserves movements — transparency totals include all of these.

procurement_paid.note: Discretionary third-party supplier payments — the real procurement footprint.

direct_payment_individual.note: Care Act 2014 + UK GDPR redactions — foster carers, SGO recipients, ASC service-user direct-payment holders. Lawfully unnamed.

political_control.tenure_note: Reform UK majority since the 1 May 2025 all-out election (41 of 68; threshold 35). Leader Cllr Martin Griffiths (Reform) since 22 May 2025 survived an internal challenge 28-12 on 14 April 2026 and was re-confirmed at the 21 May 2026 AGM. A 2021-created unitary inheriting the former Northamptonshire CC intervention legacy. Same may_2025 cohort as Kent, LCC, the counties and West Northants (previously mis-tagged may_2026_new).
